title: God numbers for Graphs, Games and Groups
summary: We describe and axiomatize finite solitaire puzzles and zero sum sequential games graph theoretically. Zermelo's theorem telling that there is a win for one of the players or a draw follows from the definitions. The god number is a geometric quantity that quantifies the number of moves necessary to solve the puzzle. In the solitaire case, the god number is the minimal distance from the initial state $v$ to the solution space $A$. If $v$ and $A$ are not specified, the god number is the graph diameter.
